info:
• AI Pics cropper improved with better preview order, capped preview height and corner resize with locked aspect ratio.
  • AI crop save now preserves the highest available cropped resolution instead of shrinking to original size.
  • AI Pics page links, live row updates and edit recrop flow were improved for faster album work.
  • AI preview thumbnails and status links were improved and album header actions were cleaned up.
  • Disk Space Usage dashboard now includes the ai folder with calculate support.
